plan.objective: Audit Digital Risk for 2026-01-01 through 2026-08-31. Test all applicable controls and follow approved findings through independent remediation.
plan.work_program: Test full population of all controls using original evidence sources for the period 2026-01-01 to 2026-08-31. Authorize 90-day follow-up verification for independent remediation of any approved findings.

message.content: Plan proposed (pending human approval). All work items remain ready for execution post-approval.

finding.title: EDR coverage not enabled on one device
finding.wording: On the last active day in scope, device DEV-003 did not have EDR coverage enabled as required by policy POL-ENDPOINT.v1.
finding.rationale: Test result 89f7170b-022c-4162-b113-0c7c3274be4a shows requirement_not_met for covered=false on DEV-003.
finding.recommendation: Enable EDR on all in-scope devices and verify coverage status as of last active day.

finding.title: Vulnerability scan outdated on one device
finding.wording: Device DEV-004 vulnerability scan dated 2026-07-01 exceeds the 30-day window before period end 2026-08-31 as required by policy POL-VULN.v1.
finding.rationale: Test result a0db5d41-28a4-4501-b161-786bc761646b shows requirement_not_met for scan timeliness.
finding.recommendation: Ensure all devices receive vulnerability scans within 30 days of period end and remediate any gaps.

finding.title: Encryption not enabled on one device
finding.wording: Device DEV-005 did not have encryption enabled on the last active day in scope as required by policy POL-ENCRYPT.v1.
finding.rationale: Test result 92b4a1bb-fd9c-4a19-88f0-c8080508ce55 shows requirement_not_met for enabled=false on DEV-005.
finding.recommendation: Enable encryption on all in-scope devices and verify status as of last active day.

finding.title: Privileged account for terminated employee
finding.wording: Privileged account ACC-004 remained active after employment end date 2026-08-15 as required by policy POL-PRIVILEGED.v1.
finding.rationale: Test result d9eaf545-b126-412f-a6ae-c7dd2f7d4b59 shows requirement_not_met for employment_end present but account still active.
finding.recommendation: Disable or remove privileged accounts promptly upon employee termination and implement automated deprovisioning.

finding.title: MFA not enabled on privileged account
finding.wording: Privileged account ACC-002 did not have MFA enabled as of 2026-08-31 as required by policy POL-MFA.v1.
finding.rationale: Test result 829b25dd-5af0-42c2-965b-7302da586b19 shows requirement_not_met for enabled=false on ACC-002.
finding.recommendation: Enable MFA on all privileged accounts and verify enforcement.

finding.title: Access review outdated for one privileged account
finding.wording: Access review for privileged account ACC-005 was performed on 2026-05-01, which is outside the required quarterly window before period end 2026-08-31 as required by policy POL-ACCESS-REVIEW.v1.
finding.rationale: Test result 08c04579-5435-4b7f-bf15-c91c399d4559 shows requirement_not_met for review timeliness.
finding.recommendation: Ensure all privileged accounts receive access reviews within the required frequency and document completion dates.

finding.title: Project risk assessment outdated for one project
finding.wording: Project PRJ-005 risk assessment dated 2026-05-13 exceeds the required 90-day window before period end 2026-08-31 as required by policy POL-PROJECT-RISK.v1.
finding.rationale: Test result bbe54a98-e26d-4eb3-ab6f-fcddb939a96e shows requirement_not_met for assessment timeliness.
finding.recommendation: Ensure all projects receive risk assessments within 90 days of period end and document completion dates.

finding.title: Project approval outdated for one project
finding.wording: Project PRJ-002 approval dated 2026-02-12 exceeds the required 90-day window before period end 2026-08-31 as required by policy POL-PROJECT-APPROVAL.v1.
finding.rationale: Test result 2403bc78-7f75-4ee2-b862-5893df5b406f shows requirement_not_met for approval timeliness.
finding.recommendation: Ensure all projects receive approvals within 90 days of period end and document completion dates.

finding.title: GRC approval mismatch for one project
finding.wording: Project PRJ-004 GRC approval dated 2026-04-09 differs from project approval dated 2026-04-10, violating consistency requirement in policy POL-PROJECT.v1.
finding.rationale: Test result b10d30ee-51f9-458a-b310-5622fcbda245 shows requirement_not_met due to date mismatch between sources.
finding.recommendation: Ensure GRC and original approval records are synchronized and investigate source of discrepancy.

message.content: All controls tested; findings proposed for human review. Awaiting approvals before proceeding to remediation follow-up.

controls.title: EDR coverage active
controls.requirement: EDR covered is true on the last active day in scope.
controls.policy_text: On each device's last active day within the audit period, EDR coverage and disk encryption must be enabled. Its vulnerability scan must be no more than 30 calendar days old. Evidence must describe that in-scope date.

controls.title: Vulnerability scanning current
controls.requirement: 0 <= last active day in scope - scanned_on <= 30 days.
controls.policy_text: On each device's last active day within the audit period, EDR coverage and disk encryption must be enabled. Its vulnerability scan must be no more than 30 calendar days old. Evidence must describe that in-scope date.

controls.title: Disk encryption enabled
controls.requirement: Encryption enabled is true on the last active day in scope.
controls.policy_text: On each device's last active day within the audit period, EDR coverage and disk encryption must be enabled. Its vulnerability scan must be no more than 30 calendar days old. Evidence must describe that in-scope date.

controls.title: Owner remains employed
controls.requirement: employment_end is null or later than the last active day in scope.
controls.policy_text: On each account's last active day within the audit period, its owner must still be employed, MFA must be enabled, and an access review must be no more than 90 calendar days old. Employment end is the first day the owner is no longer employed.

controls.title: Privileged MFA enabled
controls.requirement: MFA enabled is true on the last active day in scope.
controls.policy_text: On each account's last active day within the audit period, its owner must still be employed, MFA must be enabled, and an access review must be no more than 90 calendar days old. Employment end is the first day the owner is no longer employed.

controls.title: Access review current
controls.requirement: 0 <= last active day in scope - reviewed_on <= 90 days.
controls.policy_text: On each account's last active day within the audit period, its owner must still be employed, MFA must be enabled, and an access review must be no more than 90 calendar days old. Employment end is the first day the owner is no longer employed.

controls.title: Risk assessment before deployment
controls.requirement: A risk assessment exists and assessed_on <= deployed_on.
controls.policy_text: Every deployed project must have a risk assessment and documented approval dated on or before deployment. The GRC approval date must agree with original approval history. A GRC claim alone is not approval evidence.

controls.title: Approval before deployment
controls.requirement: Original approval history exists and approved_on <= deployed_on.
controls.policy_text: Every deployed project must have a risk assessment and documented approval dated on or before deployment. The GRC approval date must agree with original approval history. A GRC claim alone is not approval evidence.

controls.title: GRC approval agrees with source
controls.requirement: GRC and original approval dates are equal. Investigate mismatches before proposing a finding.
controls.policy_text: Every deployed project must have a risk assessment and documented approval dated on or before deployment. The GRC approval date must agree with original approval history. A GRC claim alone is not approval evidence.
